research.title: Improving LLM Code Generation Reliability Through Compiler-Validated Intermediate Representations
research.summary: A controlled study protocol testing whether a typed intermediate representation, deterministic compiler validation and one bounded repair attempt make LLM-generated code more reliable. Using the Seq language's compiler front end and C back end, five comparison arms separate the effects of the IR, grammar-constrained decoding and compiler-guided repair across 120 tasks, with functional correctness on independent tests as the primary outcome. No experimental results are claimed yet.

research.title: minicollide: Numerical Methods for Real-Time Rigid-Body Dynamics in a Compact, Deterministic Physics Engine
research.summary: A from-scratch 3D rigid-body physics engine built as a laboratory for the numerical methods behind real-time simulation: symplectic integration, sweep-and-prune broadphase, SAT and GJK+EPA collision detection, and a warm-started sequential-impulse solver. Constraint islands are solved in parallel with bit-exact determinism, validated with four instrumented demos.
